name: Anila
description: A place that has been arranged to make you wait. One road in, and along it a sequence of gates that all stand open, each with a bench beside it. The benches are worn and the gates are not, and every gate faces the same way.

pois.label: First gate
pois.text: Open, and hooked back against the wall so it cannot swing. The hook is a shaped iron pin, made for the purpose rather than improvised.

pois.label: Worn bench
pois.text: Seat and back both hollowed. The hollowing is even, which means many people sat the same way for a long time, and none of them fidgeted.

pois.label: Last gate
pois.text: Standing at the far end, open like the rest, and beyond it the road simply stops at a low wall. There is nothing past the wall. There is a bench on this side of it too.
